title: Lue Elizondo's superiors who saw the phenomenon as demonic

tellings.quote: think in in Lou's book I found the part where he talks about some of his superiors where they had this demonic

plain: Some of the superiors of Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence officer who ran AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, are said to have seen the phenomenon as demonic. Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear weapons site, tells Michels he found this in Imminent, Elizondo's 2024 book, in a part where Elizondo writes about superiors with that view. If true, people senior to the man studying UFOs for the Pentagon thought of them in religious terms.
